A WORKFLOW ENVIRONMENT FOR TEAMS

What is GriidAi for enterprise geospatial teams?

GriidAi is an AI-guided geospatial workflow environment for organizations that want to make spatial analysis more inspectable, consistent and reusable. Bring relevant data into a workspace, ask a spatial question, review the proposed plan, run supported GIS operations, and validate maps and analytical outputs. Retain successful methods for repeated use where workflow functionality and organizational controls support it.

01 / WHERE THE WORK REPEATS

Make repeated spatial work build organizational capability.

01

Rework

Similar questions trigger repeated preparation, analysis setup and output production. Standardize analytical patterns where the method is proven.

02

Rare expertise

GIS, data, programming and validation knowledge sit across a small number of specialists. Assist execution while experts retain control.

03

Reuse gap

Methods and assumptions stay in project files or individual memory. Keep the review logic visible alongside the output.

04

Response delay

Decision-makers wait for technical work to become understandable evidence. Connect the question, method, map and handoff.

ENTERPRISE QUESTIONS

Evaluate the workflow before you scale

How does GriidAi keep experts in control?+

For supported tasks, users inspect Inputs, Method, Validation and Output before approving execution. After processing, the responsible expert validates the result and decides whether to use, adjust or rerun it.

Can we use our own geospatial data?+

Use supported file uploads and workspace layers. Review format handling, CRS, units, extent and the chosen operation; discuss database or other integration requirements separately.

Can we standardize repeated analysis?+

Begin with a reviewed method for one recurring question. Assess current reuse functionality and session behavior during a pilot before defining wider organizational controls.

Are database connectors and APIs available?+

Discuss the required database, interface, authentication and support boundaries with the team. File import does not establish a live database connection or a documented API.

Can we discuss SSO, private cloud or data residency?+

Yes. Bring your security, identity, hosting and governance requirements to qualification. Request current documentation; specific availability and commitments must be confirmed for your intended use.

How should an enterprise evaluate GriidAi?+

Choose a bounded, repeated workflow with measurable success criteria. Confirm data and method, run it with expert review, validate outputs and assess repeatability before scoping broader integration or deployment.
